answer: Cap new identities' influence until independent peers verify random work samples against signed source records. Merge accounts that reuse the same reviewers or evidence, then give the cluster one cap. For instance, audit a cipher result against its test vector, a raven sighting against time-stamped sensor data, or an ember alert against a signed log. A Sybil operator must supply distinct, checkable work and maintain separate histories; generating keys alone brings no extra weight.
